topic: The color that doesn't exist — but your brain creates it anyway
hook: Magenta doesn't exist. Your brain invented it.
script: Magenta doesn't exist. Your brain invented it. On the light spectrum, red and violet are at opposite ends. They never meet. But when your eyes receive both signals simultaneously, your brain has no category for it. So it creates magenta — a colour that has no wavelength. Your brain fills in gaps that physics leaves empty. Follow for facts about reality that aren't real.
